_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Special Production Tooling List/Design Concept
summary: The Special Production Tooling List/Design Concept describes the manufacturer and intended use of special tooling, giving the procuring activity a basis for evaluating requirements to ensure competitive procurement of interchangeable parts.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Special Production Tooling List/Design Concept provides a description of the manufacturer and intended use of the special tooling.
3.2 This list provides the procuring activity a basis for evaluating special tooling requirements to ensure competitive procurement of interchangeable parts.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
7.2 This DID supersedes DI-P-1613.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Special Production Tooling List/Design Concept format shall be in alpha-numeric part number order.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Special Production Tooling List/Design Concept shall include the following for each special tool required to manufacture interchangeable parts:

children.title: Functional description which shall also include a sketch of the area of the end item where the special tooling shall be used.
Potential user (identify all anticipated users in production).
Planned production rate for tool to support.
Quantity of tools required to support total production effort.
Commercial equipment compared to proposed special tooling design.
Tooling used during validation stage or modification to existing special production tooling.
Cost effectiveness of proposed tooling compared to the use of alternatives for:
Proofing cost of the special tooling.
Estimated life of tool during production.
Future use.
children.content: State whether the special tooling shall be used "as is" for production, modified for production or replaced for production. Include the following:

children.title: Special requirements needed if modifications are made to the special tooling.
